Test strength

You will learn

How to measure a suite, not admire it: caught mutants, deleted tests, vacuous passes.

Coverage says what you ran; mutation says what your running is worth. A suite's strength is its kill count on faults you chose, its behavior when tests are deleted, its share of passes that executed an assert. The widget is the reference side of that measuring: all 6 reference bitstreams present and read -- 84.4 ms, best of 5 -- so a speed or strength number always stands on a reference somebody pinned. Measure the suite, or admit you are admiring it.

Try it

Measure one thing twice, two ways, in the refs widget's style; then say which of your own suite's numbers has no denominator.

Open the interactive lesson →

The part table in far.t27 matches prjxray-db part.json, all 6 reference bitstreams are present, and bitwalk reads all 6 in 84.4 ms (best of 5).
